_comment: Phase 3 greybox precinct: a church and a dormitory for the one monk to walk between, and a work site out in the meadow. Anchors are cell coordinates near the founding site; the renderer and Population search nearby for a flat, dry cell, so these stay robust if the valley preset is retuned. 'door' is the offset from the found footprint cell to the cell an agent stands on to enter. Sizes are in metres.
